script.vo01: There's an agent to guide care teams through these processes. It pulls data from Microsoft Teams, engages you directly in Microsoft Teams.
script.vo02: Before, they would have needed to jump across multiple systems to manually gather insights, piecing the picture together by hand, and hoping nothing moved while they worked.
script.vo03: It reads Microsoft Teams. It engages you in Microsoft Teams and Outlook. And it can accelerate authorization processes and improve documentation accuracy, showing the reasoning behind every answer.
script.vo04: Let's say a manager needs to accelerate authorization processes. But what if the manager wants to go a step further? The agent handles the analysis and offers a set of targeted recommendations right in their workflow. Work like this used to require cross-referencing different systems by hand.
script.vo05: Now, with unified data context across Microsoft Teams, the agent can rapidly generate a phased plan with quick wins. For risk mitigation, the agent helps as well, outlining a strategy that keeps the work on track. When the detail is needed, they simply ask, and the agent quickly compiles a clear summary.
script.vo06: It can improve documentation accuracy in the same conversation, without anyone switching tools. Finally, the agent creates a monitoring plan, so teams keep the effort aligned to the metrics they are measured on.
script.vo_payoff: With Prior Authorization Agent, care teams get guided assistance embedded directly into their workflows.
script.vo_helps: The result?, accelerate authorization processes, improve documentation accuracy, and better reduce care delays.
script.vo_cta: Get started on your agentic journey today. Talk to your Microsoft representative to learn more.
